subject: Request for limited PT findings + remediation attestation — controlled access
messages:
From: Danielle Thomas <danielle.thomas@orion-fin.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Li <peter.li@orion-fin.com>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 17:12:00 -04:00
Subject: Request: Full penetration test report for vendor review

Hi Rishi,

Hope you’re well. Orion’s vendor security team is completing our Q3 vendor risk assessment and we need the most recent penetration test report that Redwood has performed (scope, findings, and remediation status) to complete our SIG/QBR. Our team typically requests the full report and appendices for internal review.

Can you provide the latest PT report and any associated remediation tracking? If full delivery isn’t possible due to confidentiality, please let us know what alternative options (redacted report, summary + attestation, or controlled review) are available and the required approvals.

Thanks — we’re on a tight timeline and would like to close this by next Friday.

Best,
Danielle Thomas
Security Manager, Vendor Risk
Orion Financial
Attachments: none
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Thomas <danielle.thomas@orion-fin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 30 Jun 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full penetration test report for vendor review

Hi Danielle — thanks for the note and for outlining your timeline. I’m Rishi on the security & compliance team at Redwood.

Short answer: we cannot share the full penetration test report or raw appendices outside of strict controls. The report contains sensitive vulnerability details (proof-of-concept data and internal host identifiers) that could create risk if distributed.

What we can provide today:
- A concise PT summary (PDF) that lists scope, severity-classified findings (high/medium/low) with remediation status and timelines.
- A remediation attestation signed by our Head of Security confirming fixes for all high-severity items and planned mitigations for outstanding medium items.
- A remediation matrix (spreadsheet) that shows PR/issue tracker references and target close dates (no exploit details).
- Option for a controlled, recorded remote review (screen-share) where we can walk your Security team through select findings under NDA and with session logging.

If you need more than that, we can arrange an on-screen-only review with our engineering leads present and require a standard mutual NDA + access request form. Please confirm which option you prefer and a couple of 30-minute windows that work for your team.

I’m attaching the PT summary and remediation matrix for your review.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PT_Summary_2026-06.pdf (summary), remediation_matrix_Orion_2026-06.xlsx (remediation tracker)
From: Danielle Thomas <danielle.thomas@orion-fin.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Peter Li <peter.li@orion-fin.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full penetration test report for vendor review

Thanks Rishi — that helps. We’re comfortable starting with the summary + remediation matrix. Two quick follow-ups:

1) For high-severity findings, can you share the CVE or a short technical rationale (one paragraph) describing the root cause and whether it required code changes, configuration changes, or infra fixes? We don’t need exploit steps, just enough context to risk-rate the finding on our side.
2) We’d like a 30-minute walkthrough with whoever owns the remediation for the high items. Does your engineering security lead or the responsible engineer need to be on that call?

Our security lead (copied) — Peter Li — can join. Suggested windows (ET): Thu 7/2 10:00–11:30 or Fri 7/3 14:00–16:00.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Danielle
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Thomas <danielle.thomas@orion-fin.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 09:47:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full penetration test report for vendor review

Hi Danielle — Karthik on the GTM side. Thanks for confirming you’ll start with the summary. I’ll coordinate the logistics for the walkthrough.

We can support either window but Rishi and our engineering security lead (Marissa) prefer Thu 7/2 13:00–13:30 PT (10:00–10:30 ET). Please confirm attendee list (yoursec lead + 2 others max) and we’ll send a calendar invite with the secure meeting link. No recordings will be shared; session will be logged for audit.

I also wanted to flag a brief internal ask: because this is a limited-disclosure event, we need a completed short access form (one page) that lists attendees and the purpose of the review. I’ve attached the form link in the invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

-Karthik
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Danielle Thomas <danielle.thomas@orion-fin.com>, Peter Li <peter.li@orion-fin.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 1 Jul 2026 10:10:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Full penetration test report for vendor review

Confirmed — Thu 7/2 13:00 PT (10:00 ET) works for us. Invite will follow from Karthik.

Pre-reqs for the session:
- Completed access form (link included in calendar invite) with attendee names/titles; max 4 external attendees.
- Signed mutual NDA or acknowledgment to the limited-disclosure terms (we accept your standard NDA; we’re adding a short exhibit listing what we won’t disclose).
- Agreement that no screenshots or recordings will be retained by external attendees; Redwood will keep session logs for audit.

Deliverables attached to this thread: PT summary (PDF) and remediation tracker (spreadsheet) — these are the only files we can provide outside the controlled review. We’ll include short one-paragraph technical rationale for each high-severity finding in the summary prior to the call.

If Orion confirms the attendees and completes the access form before EOD Wed, we’ll send the final pre-brief (with the one-paragraph rationales) by 09:00 PT Thu.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_PT_Summary_2026-06.pdf, remediation_matrix_Orion_2026-06.xlsx
